name: A2 Crystal Ball and TAPS detector system

placements.note: Institute building (campus-grade); start = earliest documented run.
placements.quote: measured with the A2 tagged-photon facilities at the Mainz Microtron, MAMI C

summary.plain: The famous Crystal Ball calorimeter, a sphere of crystals around the target, combined with the TAPS wall of crystals in the forward direction and a central tracker, covering almost all directions for photons and neutral mesons.
summary.technical: Crystal Ball (highly segmented NaI(Tl) ball) with the TAPS detector as a forward wall and a central tracker: geometrical acceptance close to 4 pi with good energy and angular resolution, especially for neutral final states; frozen-spin butanol targets after the MAMI-C upgrade.

technology.quote: The experimental apparatus consists of the famous Crystal Ball together with the TAPS detector as a forward wall, and a central tracker.
technology.value: Crystal Ball calorimeter with the TAPS forward wall and a central tracker, acceptance close to 4 pi
